caption: The drawing depicts a detailed and realistic rendering of a bronze-colored statue of a dog, which is posed in a seated position atop a rectangular base. The dog has long, textured fur, floppy ears, and its head is turned slightly toward its left. The front right leg of the dog is raised, with the paw held off the ground, while the other legs are positioned naturally on the base. The base of the statue is flat and rectangular, colored in tones of brown consistent with the statue itself. The background is plain and light beige, with no additional objects or designs, focusing attention entirely on the statue. In the bottom right corner, there is an inscription reading "Samuel Fineman Del. 2591."
title: Cast Iron Dog
